question: As per NITI Ayog data, the total fertility rate in India in 2016 was:
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 1**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per NITI Ayog data, the total fertility rate in India in 2016 was **2.3**.
 
• The total fertility rate (TFR) is a measure of the average number of children that would be born to a woman over her lifetime.
 
• A TFR of 2.1 is considered the replacement level fertility, meaning the population will remain stable if this rate is maintained.
 
• India's TFR has been declining over the years due to various factors such as increased use of contraception, education, and economic development.
 
• The decline in TFR is a positive indicator of progress in family planning and women's health initiatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The NITI Ayog (National Institution for Transforming India) is a policy think tank of the Government of India, established with the aim to achieve sustainable development goals.
 
• It was formed on January 1, 2015, replacing the Planning Commission.
 
• The NITI Ayog's primary function is to foster cooperative federalism through structured support initiatives and mechanisms with the states on a continuous basis.
 
• It provides relevant strategic and technical advice to the central and state governments on various policy matters.
 
• Fertility rates are crucial for planning and implementing public health policies and programs.
